sentences.text: Yangavis was a small bird with a wingspan of approximately half a meter.
Unlike many modern birds, the claw of its second finger was not strongly reduced.
Its third toe was notably longer than the length of its tarsometatarsus.
The species Yangavis confucii was named and described by Wang Min and Zhou Zhonghe in 2018.
The specific name confucii honors Confucius and references the family Confuciusornithidae.
The holotype fossil was found in the Aptian-aged Yixian Formation.
This holotype consists of an almost complete articulated skeleton that is compressed on a single plate.
Yangavis is classified as a basal pygostylian genus within the family Confuciusornithidae.
Yangavis lived in the area of present China during the Early Cretaceous.
It lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
